privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This is an editable starting draft for the business owner to review. Complete every bracketed field and verify the content with a qualified legal adviser before publication.
sections: Who is responsible for your data?
Data controller: [[FULL LEGAL / BUSINESS NAME]]. Postal address: [[POSTAL ADDRESS]]. Email: [[PRIVACY EMAIL]]. Phone: [[PHONE NUMBER]]. Enter accurate details for the entity operating this website.
What information may we receive?

When you contact us or request an appointment, we may receive your name, phone number, email address, vehicle make and model, engine details and message. The site uses essential browser storage to remember your consent choice. Language preference is saved only if you enable functional cookies.
Why do we use this information?

We use information you submit to respond to enquiries, discuss or arrange appointments and provide requested services. Before publication, the owner must identify the legal basis for each purpose, retention periods and processors used.
WhatsApp and other providers

When you submit the form, the site prepares a message and opens WhatsApp only after your action. WhatsApp and other external services have their own privacy policies. The owner should list providers, international transfers and safeguards where applicable: [[PROVIDERS AND SAFEGUARDS]].
How long is information kept?
We keep information only as long as needed for its purpose or as required by law. The owner must specify periods for customer enquiries, service records and consent records: [[RETENTION PERIODS]].
Your rights and how to contact us

Depending on the applicable law, you may have rights to access, correct or erase information, restrict or object to processing, or withdraw consent. Contact [[PRIVACY EMAIL]] to exercise these rights. You may also complain to the relevant data protection authority: [[AUTHORITY NAME AND CONTACT]]. The owner must verify this for each relevant jurisdiction.
Updates
This page may be updated when our services or data practices change. Effective date: [[DATE]].

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This is an editable starting draft. Its descriptions must match the technologies actually used by the published website.
sections: What is stored in your browser?

The site stores a consent choice with selected categories, the time of the choice and the notice version. This storage is needed to apply your choice. Language preference is saved only if you allow functional cookies.
Strictly necessary cookies
Always active. They remember your consent decision and notice version so the notice does not reappear on every visit and your choices are respected. They cannot be disabled in the settings panel.
Functional cookies
Optional. They remember your language preference and any additional settings that may be added. Turning them off does not prevent basic site use.
Analytics cookies

Optional. They may be used to understand traffic and how visitors use the site. No analytics tool is included in this version. Before adding one, the owner must list its name, provider, purpose, lifetime and any transfers.
Marketing cookies

Optional. They may be used for advertising measurement or marketing tracking. No marketing tool is included in this version. Any future tool must be documented here and blocked until consent is given.
Change or withdraw consent
You can change or withdraw your choice at any time using “Cookie Settings” in the site footer. A change is saved with a new consent time and version. Review date: [[DATE]].

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: This is an editable draft, not the business’s final terms. The owner must complete the bracketed fields and obtain legal review for the countries where services are offered.
sections: Business identity and contact
Services are provided by [[FULL LEGAL / BUSINESS NAME]], at [[ADDRESS]], contact [[EMAIL / PHONE]]. Add official details only after verifying them.
Website information

Descriptions and the performance calculator are informational and indicative. Estimates are not an offer, diagnosis or guarantee; actual results depend on the vehicle, engine, condition, equipment and use.
Appointment enquiries and orders

Submitting the form opens WhatsApp with an enquiry and does not by itself create a contract or confirmed appointment. The business confirms appointments and work separately. The owner should add quotation, payment, cancellation and warranty terms, if applicable: [[COMMERCIAL TERMS]].
Lawful vehicle use

Customers should ensure that any vehicle modification and use complies with safety, emissions, inspection and local legal requirements. Applicable restrictions and approvals should be discussed before work begins.
Liability and governing law

Liability limits and governing law depend on the applicable jurisdiction and are not defined in this draft. The owner must complete these after legal advice: [[LAW / VENUE / LIABILITY TERMS]]. Nothing here is intended to exclude rights that cannot legally be excluded.
